title: 推理期增强 ablation：实证检验 §8「推理期调参无效」
question: Does increasing planner inference-period budget (horizon / CEM iters / action clip) improve frozen JEPA-WM task-success, or does success stay pinned at the flat-cost floor (confirming KW-LEWM-0005 §8 weak action conditioning)?
design: same JEPAWMAdapter + stable-worldmodel harness + same 0004 25-task subset; only planner settings vary; no training

pre_registration.K1_harness_check: baseline success Wilson CI must overlap K4 [0.004,0.105]; point estimate within [0,0.08]
pre_registration.K2_confirm: all variants' success CI overlap K4 AND point-estimate gain <0.10 -> CONFIRMS_SECTION_8
pre_registration.K2_refute: any variant success >0.15 AND CI lower bound >0.105 -> REFUTES_SECTION_8 -> pivot to cost-metric repair
pre_registration.note: both outcomes are valid results; only K1 harness breakage is a Kill

kill_criteria_results.K1_detail: baseline 0/25 success, Wilson CI [0.0,0.133] overlaps K4 [0.004,0.105]; point estimate 0.00 in [0,0.08]
kill_criteria_results.K2_detail: V1 0.04 / V2 0.00 / V3 0.04; all CIs overlap K4; highest CI lower bound 0.007 < 0.105

results.verdict_detail: all variants pinned at flat-cost floor; weak action conditioning confirmed, inference tuning futile

key_finding: 3x optimisation budget (V1: CEM 10->30 steps, 2.96x wall time) bought 0/25 -> 1/25. Inference-period budget is decoupled from success rate - exactly the prediction of a flat cost landscape. Lengthening the horizon (V2) even reduced block displacement median (35.10 -> 17.21).

evidence_line.note: the previous four lines (latent mobility/leverage, closed-loop correlation, paired behaviour, model-free floor) are all observational; 0006 actively manipulates inference settings, so it carries higher causal strength

post_hoc_extension.finding: out-of-play rate rose consistently across all three variants (0.04 -> 0.36 / 0.24 / 0.16); V1 paired McNemar p=0.0215 but Bonferroni-corrected p=0.064 -> NOT significant after correction
post_hoc_extension.honest_reading: direction is consistent and suggests inference-period scaling may be harmful rather than merely ineffective, but with n=25 and 3 tests it does not reach corrected significance. Hypothesis generator only; must not be cited as a conclusion.

pairing_lesson.issue: initial pairing used episode_idx alone and produced n=24 instead of 25
pairing_lesson.root_cause: episode 192 is sampled TWICE in this task set with different (start_step, goal_step) = (80,105) and (101,126) and different start_state - two distinct tasks sharing an episode_idx
pairing_lesson.fix: use the triple task key (episode_idx, start_step, goal_step) established in KW-LEWM-0005c; added an R0 pairing-completeness gate
pairing_lesson.generalisation: any cross-experiment paired analysis on this task set MUST use the triple key, not episode_idx alone

caveats: n=25 per variant; CIs are very wide (e.g. [0.007,0.195])
V1/V3 1/25 vs baseline 0/25 must NOT be read as an improvement from inference budget
baseline 0/25 on the 25-task subset vs K4 1/50 on the full set is CONSISTENT (the single K4 success is not in the first 25 tasks), not harness breakage
0006b is POST-HOC and does not survive Bonferroni correction
still E1: single checkpoint, single seed=42, single 25-task subset, no third-party validation
residual approximations: n=25 not 50, partial-shard scaler, locally-rendered pixels, shard 0, single goal_offset=25, 4-dim proprio reconstruction
must NOT present these numbers as the 50-task head-to-head, nor claim official benchmark or model superiority
